      Pull to spin

      Pay table

      Your bet is split across 5 lines: the 3 rows and both diagonals. Pays are per line, times the line bet. The Dueck face is wild and doubles any win it helps make. This machine pays back about 95% over time, just like a real one.

      The shoe

      Table rules

      Decks in the shoe
      Dealer on soft 17

      A real shoe: every card is dealt from shuffled decks and leaves the shoe until the cut card comes out, so card counting really works. Blackjack pays 3 to 2. Double on any two cards, also after a split. Split up to 4 hands (aces get one card each). Late surrender. Insurance and even money pay 2 to 1. Rule changes take effect on the next shuffle.

      Pick a bet size, then press an odds button to bet. Win: your horse finishes 1st. Place: 1st or 2nd. Show: top 3. The number is what you get back per Dueck bet.

        What it pays

        A single-zero wheel with all 37 pockets in their real order. The ball's pocket is drawn fairly the moment you spin. When the ball lands on 0, every even-money bet (red, black, odd, even, 1–18, 19–36) gets half back (la partage), so the house edge is just 1.35% on those and 2.7% on the rest.

        This run

        Goalseach pays Duecks

        Ski hirepaid in Duecks

        Records

        Hold (mouse, touch or Space) to crouch and pick up speed, let go to jump. In the air, hold or press Left to backflip, Right to frontflip, and Z, X or C to grab. Land with your skis along the slope, and let go of a grab before you touch down. Tricks chain into a combo while you keep landing them; it's banked when the bar runs out, and lost if you crash. Jump onto rails to grind, smash snowmen, and stay ahead of the avalanche. Down tucks for speed. Every run pays Duecks.

        Dueck's Pizzeria ⭐ 0 Cash0

        This round

        Knivespaid in Duecks

        Records

        Swipe the mouse across the food (no clicking needed; on a phone, swipe your finger) to slice pizzas and toppings as they fly out of the kitchen. Slice three or more in one swipe for a combo. Never slice a pineapple. In Classic, dropping three things or slicing a pineapple ends the round; in Rush you get 60 seconds and a pineapple costs 10 points. Gelato slows time, chili starts a frenzy and the golden pizza doubles your points. Every point pays Duecks, and better knives pay more.

        Night Shift at Dueck's 🌙 0 Cash0

        Tonight

        Who's out there

        Records

        After midnight the animatronics wander. Cameras (Space) show where they are. When one vanishes from a hall, hold that door's light (Q/E) and shut the door (A/D) if it's there. When the duct rattles, shut the vent (S). Hold the torch (F, or press and hold the window) on L'Ananas until it backs off. Doors, lights and cameras all drain power: run out and the lights go dark. Reach 6 AM to get paid in Duecks.

        Rosterpaid in Duecks

        Records

        Pick a play, then run it. Tap a receiver to throw to him (or press 1–5). Green badges are open, red are covered. Tap (or Space) to tuck the ball and run. With the ball, hold and move up or down (or Up/Down) to steer, and tap or Space to juke a tackler. On 4th down you can punt or kick: stop the needle in the green. When the rivals have the ball, call your defence. Win 7 league games, make the top four and take the Golden Dueck Bowl. Touchdowns, wins and titles pay Duecks; train your players in the Roster.

        Tackle shoppaid in Duecks

        Journal

        Hold (mouse or Space) to charge a cast, let go to throw. Your lure sinks and the camera follows it down: Left/Right steer it, Down sinks faster, hold Up to stop it where it is, hold to reel it up. Your rod decides how deep the line goes, so upgrade it to reach the reef wall, the twilight zone, the midnight zone and the abyss. It gets dark down there: your lure carries a little light, and the glow lure lights up more. When a fish nibbles, wait for the ! and click to hook it, then keep it inside the green bar until it's landed. Rest the lure on a treasure on the bottom and click to snag it.
